def solve(case):
    nodes = case['nodes']
    required_symbols = case['required_symbols']
    id_to_node = {node['id']: node for node in nodes}
    # Build children mapping
    children_of = {}
    for node in nodes:
        pid = node['parent']
        if pid is not None:
            children_of.setdefault(pid, []).append(node['id'])
    # Initialize retained set
    retained = set(id_to_node.keys())
    removed_order = []
    # Sort nodes by depth descending, then ID ascending
    nodes_sorted = sorted(nodes, key=lambda x: (-x['depth'], x['id']))
    for node in nodes_sorted:
        nid = node['id']
        if nid not in retained:
            continue
        # Conditions to be candidate for removal
        if nid == 'root':
            continue
        if not node['removable']:
            continue
        if node['symbol'] in required_symbols:
            continue
        # Check if any direct child is retained
        child_ids = children_of.get(nid, [])
        if any(cid in retained for cid in child_ids):
            continue
        # Compute subtree (including nid) that is currently retained
        # Do BFS from nid over retained nodes
        subtree_nodes = {nid}
        queue = [nid]
        while queue:
            cur = queue.pop()
            for child in children_of.get(cur, []):
                if child in retained:
                    if child not in subtree_nodes:
                        subtree_nodes.add(child)
                        queue.append(child)
        # Simulate removal
        new_retained = retained - subtree_nodes
        # Check if all required symbols present
        symbols_present = set()
        for rid in new_retained:
            symbols_present.add(id_to_node[rid]['symbol'])
        if all(req in symbols_present for req in required_symbols):
            # Remove permanently
            retained = new_retained
            removed_order.append(nid)
    # After loop
    retained_sorted = sorted(retained)
    return {"removed_node_ids": removed_order, "retained_node_ids": retained_sorted}
